purpose: Read-only, test-only state snapshot definition for failed authoritative construction.

states.snapshotMethod: direct captured array reference; no production-file modification
states.notes: The array is >1M elements, so full own-key materialization is intentionally replaced by numeric-own count, hole count, edge indices and selected identity-sensitive entries.
Stage 2B proved successful construction can legitimately churn some existing prefix cells; raw full-array equality is therefore not the sole invariant.

states.snapshotMethod: capture WeakMap objects at bootstrap and query only known keys
states.limitations: WeakMap cardinality is never enumerated; raw scalar counter is not directly exported, so monotonic advancement is inferred only when assigned IDs are observable through known-key get().

states.snapshotMethod: capture Map instances created during authoritative/public bootstrap
states.notes: Exact semantic label of every captured Map is not inferred from ordinal position alone. Stage 2B/4D supplies the semantic map-family attribution.

states.snapshotMethod: capture WeakSet instances and query only known keys
